class.name: SteamBrowserRequest
class.brief_description: A reusable additional-origin policy for future Steam browser pages.
class.description: Build independent policies using [method SteamBrowser.allow_origins]. Each opening binds the resulting page to its own fixed policy and original client scope.

method.name: open
method.description: Await a [SteamBrowserPageResult] after submitting creation and initial navigation under this policy. HTTPS permits its initial origin. HTTP is available only for an explicitly included numeric loopback origin at the same port.
